create_PlaceCellEnsemble: create a PlaceCellEnsemble with configurable number of cells, standard deviation, and position bounds for grid-cell network training targets
create_HeadDirectionCellEnsemble: create a HeadDirectionCellEnsemble with configurable number of cells and concentration parameter for head direction cell targets
build_CellEnsemble_targets: build CellEnsemble targets from position or angle inputs using softmax, voronoi, sample, or normalized target modes
build_CellEnsemble_loss: build CellEnsemble loss using softmax or sigmoid cross entropy with configurable label smoothing for grid-cell network training
test_one_hot_max: test the one_hot_max function that computes one-hot vectors by setting the index with the maximum value to one
